reason: The free first visit and the gated Baby Nook for under-2s make it worth trying once, since I would not have to pay to find out if my toddler is safe there. I would not pay beyond that until I have seen how it actually runs.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? The capacity limit and the Baby Nook sound good, but 5-year-olds are in the same room and I do not know how it is policed.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in person during the free visit and finding the Baby Nook is truly separate and staff keep older kids out of it. Posted age-split hours for under-2s would also help.
